intro: Lesson 43: 3.3 Sawm: its role and significance in Muslim life today. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Point 1: unity. Develop: Muslims break the fast together and pray taraweeh, so the masjid is full every night. Point 2: care for the poor. Develop: zakat al-fitr is paid before Eid (Bukhari and Muslim), so everyone can celebrate.
